detail.longDescription: # GetFediHired # FediHire : I'm looking for a job (EU-remote, preferably part-time). I have 12+ years of experience in security, from PhD to security engineer and security architect. I know my way around # ThreatModelling , # appsec , Hashicorp # Vault , # devsecops , # Kubernetes security, # Gatekeeper , infrastructure/#cloudsecurity, IAM/RBAC, # Keycloak and many other things. Also I'm able to pick up new things fairly quickly. I'm generally quite thorough, and good at paying attention to details (which I think is essential in security). If you need some experienced security engineer or architect, or know someone who does, let's talk!
